svg.title: L4 Detail -- OpenID Connect authorization code login
svg.desc: The client redirects the user's browser to the authorization server. The user signs in and consents, and the server redirects the browser back to the client with an authorization code. The client sends the code to the token endpoint and receives an ID token and an access token, then validates the ID token.
